title: Why I Stopped Drinking Coconut Water
hook: I drank large amounts of coconut water for years because I thought I needed it to stay hydrated. I was drinking calories and sugar for nothing.
body:
A big 1-liter bottle has about 180 calories and almost 40 grams of sugar. That's almost as much sugar as a can of Coke.

And it doesn't hydrate you any better than water. In one study, men got dehydrated on a treadmill, then rehydrated with coconut water, a sports drink or plain water. They all worked the same.

Now I use a zero-calorie electrolyte powder in my water. If you're trying to lose belly fat, don't drink your calories, even the ones that sound healthy.
close: Subscribe to my channel, and go to sixpackabs.com for more nutrition tips.
